doc: Identity lifetime: tombstones of retired ids and import records (ARCH1-R05, ARCH1-R65).

types.name: fabric.identity.tombstone

fields.name: last_record
fields.doc: Object id of the last record object written under the id.

fields.name: retired_by
fields.doc: Tx id of the transaction that retired the id.

types.doc: A tombstone leaf (kind 3): a retired id keeps its last record object id (ARCH1-R05).

types.name: fabric.identity.import_record

fields.name: system
fields.doc: Name of the external system, such as a tool or a file format.

fields.name: external_id
fields.doc: Identifier of the object inside the external system.

fields.name: locator
fields.doc: Where the external object was read from.

fields.name: content
fields.doc: Digest of the external content at import time.

types.doc: Maps an external object to a record id with an imported-scheme id (ARCH1-R65).
